scope: Theorem 1.2 of the manuscript “Finite algebraic envelopes and the Boone–Higman conjecture” (preprints/Finite-algebraic-envelopes-and-the-Boone-Higman-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 250 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ff461d9e2465f187), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every finitely generated group with decidable word problem embeds in a finitely presented group Γ admitting a faithful two-transitive action on a countably infinite set. Every point stabilizer of this action is finitely generated.
